newsitem.title: USA: Israeli leader arrives for talks with Clinton.
newsitem.headline: Israeli leader arrives for talks with Clinton.

text.p: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu arrived in Washington on Wednesday for meetings with President Bill Clinton, congressional leaders and other key U.S. officials.

Netanyahu's plane landed at Andrews Air Force Base in nearby Maryland, an Israeli embassy official said. The prime minister and Clinton will hold talks at the White House on Thursday afternoon on future Middle East peace moves.
